name: Camping 101: Tailoring

angles.text: Tailors can weave a Faction Banner to inspire travelers and raise morale at camp during long expeditions.
Alliance adventurers are directed to Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn to stitch a faction banner.

faq.answer: Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest teaches skilled tailors to make a Faction Banner. The banner inspires travelers and raises morale at camp.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Camping 101: Tailoring?

faq.answer: Eldrin is an artisan at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. He teaches skilled tailors to craft faction banners for camps.
faq.q: Who is Eldrin and where can he be found?

aliases: what does the tailoring banner do
faq.answer: A Faction Banner inspires travelers and raises morale at camp. Its emblem offers weary travelers resolve as they journey through hostile lands.
faq.q: What does the Faction Banner do for a camp?

aliases: can any tailor make a banner
faq.answer: Tailors must first prove their skill before Eldrin teaches them the craft. They need honed needlework to weave and assemble the banner.
faq.q: What requirements are needed to learn the craft from Eldrin?

faq.answer: The Eastvale Logging Camp lies in the eastern woods of Elwynn Forest, along the road toward Redridge Mountains. Local craftspeople and workers gather at this logging hub.
faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp located?

faq.answer: Eldrin is in the heart of Elwynn Forest, within Alliance territory. The instruction there is for Alliance-aligned craftsmen from the eastern settlements.
faq.q: Is this task exclusive to Alliance tailors?

sections.body: Eldrin, an artisan at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest, guides skilled needleworkers. Tailoring makes garments and bags, but it can also sustain a journey. Those who have proven their skill with thread and loom can learn to make camp accessories for travel through the wilderness.
sections.title: A Weaver's Purpose in the Wild

sections.body: The Faction Banner is the chief craft Eldrin teaches. It stands beside a traveler's fire, where its emblem can hearten those on dangerous journeys and in battle. A banner at camp gives weary travelers a familiar sign of resolve and helps them press on through hostile lands.
sections.title: Banners of Morale

summary: In Elwynn Forest, skilled clothworkers are sent to Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp. He teaches them to weave a Faction Banner that inspires travelers and raises morale at wilderness camps.
